info.title: SmartFactory AI — Platform API
info.description: Advisory-only predictive-maintenance platform. All data is synthetic. No PLC control path exists.

get.summary: Who am I: subject, username, tenant and roles from the validated token.
Plants of the caller's tenant with their lines and asset counts.
Assets of the caller's tenant, optionally filtered by line, criticality or text.

post.summary: Register an asset on a line (administrator).

get.summary: One asset with its sensor mappings.

put.summary: Update an asset; send the version you read to avoid overwriting someone else's change (administrator).

post.summary: Map a new sensor to an asset (administrator).
Raise a maintenance request for an asset; creates a work order in state Requested.

get.summary: Work orders, optionally filtered by status or asset. Technicians see only their assigned work.
One work order with checklist, history, findings and the actions the caller may take now.

put.summary: Edit the plan before work starts (planner).

post.summary: Approve a requested work order (planner, reliability manager).
Reject a requested work order with a reason (planner, reliability manager).
Assign a technician and a date (planner).
Put scheduled or running work on hold with a reason (planner or assigned technician).
Resume work from hold (planner or assigned technician).
Complete the work once every checklist item has a status (assigned technician).
Close completed work with a disposition (planner).
Cancel open work with a reason (planner).

put.summary: Record the outcome of one checklist item (assigned technician).

post.summary: Record a finding with a condition label (assigned technician).
Attach a JPEG, PNG or PDF (max 5 MB) to a finding (assigned technician).

get.summary: Download an attachment. Served as a download with the type detected at upload.
Module liveness marker; replaced by real endpoints from Week 2.
Audit events of the caller's tenant, newest first, optionally for one aggregate.
Recompute the tenant's hash chain and report the first broken record, if any.
